defects.description: Platform currently implements BAR_1D (truss) and QUAD_2D (in-plane membrane) but lacks transverse plate bending formulation (w, theta_x, theta_y degrees of freedom). Out-of-plane plate bending cannot be modeled without a true plate/shell element formulation.
Artificial stiffness line (stiffness = E * 1e-7) and early loop break (iter > 0) completely removed and replaced by genuine StructuralAnalysisEngine.runFEA and Aitken dynamic relaxation.
Empty class stubs replaced with genuine implementations of ALE distance-decay smoothing, cell volume compression check, element inversion detection, atomic rollback, and Aitken dynamic relaxation.
Node indexing fixed from unsafe nodeId-1 assumption to robust mesh.nodes.findIndex(n => n.id === nodeId).
